rationale_for_no_platform_mutation: Phase 2 is the binary-acquisition phase. Adding @font-face declarations or <link rel=preload> tags pointing to non-existent woff2 files would emit 404s and console warnings, polluting the cathedral. Tokens (--font-*, --type-voice-*) remain on their Resonance v2 stacks (Cairo, Tajawal, Reem Kufi, etc) which still resolve via system + Phase-1-Thmanyah-stub fallback. Once owner runs the bootstrap and commits the binaries, Phase 3 (Voice Bindings) appends the @font-face block and re-routes the stacks in a single semantically-coherent pass.
